name: timber_structure
description: Exposed timber frame (木构梁架): three truss syntaxes (简支 truss_simple / 带立柱 truss_kingpost / 简化锤梁 truss_hammerbeam), corbel 托臂, and 45-degree knee brace 斜撑. Includes beam-end taper (梁端收分), post-beam bolster pads (梁柱交接垫块), and purlins spaced for the exposed-truss rhythm (stats-calibrated spacing 2-5).
when_to_use: Timber-framed styles (medieval_house / sakura_japanese / chinese_palace) when roof trusses, eave brackets, or post-beam braces should show. Trusses: run once per truss position, `spacing` apart along the ridge run; origin = left wall-head at wall-TOP layer. corbel/brace: origin = the attach column base on the wall face, facing = outward from the wall. All log-axis/stair states are script-derived — never hand-edit them in the output (禁止手改方向状态).

kind.notes: truss = full A-frame; kingpost adds center post+bolsters; hammerbeam drops the tie beam mid-span; corbel = stacked eave bracket; brace = 45-deg knee brace

origin.notes: truss: left wall-head at wall top; corbel/brace: wall-face attach column base

facing.notes: truss: gable-end direction (span rotates with it); corbel/brace: outward from the wall

span.notes: tie-beam length; for corbel = projection courses, brace = reach

spacing.notes: trusses only: purlin length toward the next truss; GrabCraft stats 柱距 2格35%/3格15%/4格35%

material.notes: any *_log (stripped ok); matching *_stairs are derived automatically
